name: stretch-1026-200334
hypothesis: Missed growth: surviving careers stall below the next level because the parent's Escalating response turns the main action into Lay low and reduce risk for long stretches, although the Defuse bought in the same quarter is what clears the risk. Evidence from the champion's 4 completed race digests: 26 of 64 main actions were Lay low, every one taken at Health 8 or more and every one in a quarter that also bought Defuse. The 2 careers that finished at L4 took 18 of their 32 main actions this way (11 and 7, one of them 10 quarters in a row); the 2 that reached L5 took 8 of 32. In both L4 careers the Lay-low stretch covered an 18-month stay at L3 in which Skill reached its ceiling for the level and stopped, while Output (and in one game Network) was still short. In one game Output was 8 to 13 across 5 Lay-low quarters, and promotion came only at the review after it rose further. In the other it was 6 to 10 across the first 4 of 6 Lay-low quarters, and promotion came only at the last review. Lay low itself never moved Output, while Report results added Output in all 8 digested quarters where Output had not yet stalled at its level. Lay low shows no protection beyond Defuse: after a Defuse quarter the next HR remark was calm in 22 of 26 Lay-low quarters and in 8 of 8 Report-results quarters, and the only blow-up in the completed games came right after the 9th Lay-low quarter in a row. In the repo's Opus digests, 11 of 13 blow-ups followed Apply for a key project (54 % of their 303 main actions), 1 followed Report results (27 %) and 1 followed Lay low (14 %). Why the change captures it: Report results to your manager and Showcase results are the published visible-results actions. They raise Output (Report results also Network and Dignity) and take on no new commitment. Making them the Escalating main action keeps G1 (Defuse every Energy phase), G2, G5 and the no-new-commitments story rule, follows G3 (no Lay low after a weak review, which the parent's Risk-over-Review order breaks), and moves the promotion inputs exactly where they stalled. Careers that spend long periods in Escalating should then reach their next promotion a review or more earlier, so more completed careers end at L5, with higher wealth from the higher salary and bonus base.
change: One edit in Priority 2 (Risk); everything else is the parent's text verbatim. Escalating main action: 'Report results to your manager, Showcase results or Repair a key relationship, whichever fits' (parent: 'Lay low and reduce risk or Repair a key relationship, whichever fits'). Added one sentence: Defuse is what clears old risk, so take Lay low and reduce risk only when Health is in the lower part of its range, because a quarter spent lying low leaves Skill, Network and Output flat and promotion needs them to grow. Kept unchanged: Defuse every Energy phase in Escalating, no new commitments, the step-down rule, the story preference for disclosing and fixing, the Protect > Risk > Review > Balance order and the end-of-run line. 436 words by wc -w including front matter (parent 393).
predicted_behaviour: Notes still carry Clear, Raised or Escalating. In Escalating quarters Defuse legacy risk appears in every Energy phase as in the parent, and the main action is Report results to your manager, Showcase results or Repair a key relationship. Lay low and reduce risk appears only with Health in the lower part of its range: close to none in completed games, against 26 of 64 main actions in the parent's 4 completed digests. Output keeps rising through Escalating stretches instead of staying flat, so careers that sit in Escalating get their L2-to-L3 and L3-to-L4 promotions a review or more earlier. Completed careers end at L5 more often than 2 of 4 and with a higher level dimension than the parent's 46 and a higher wealth dimension than its 33. Completion rate, trust-crisis exits and the risk-control dimension stay close to the parent's: 10 of 12 completed, no trust crisis among the 12 latest games, risk control 74.
refutation: Refuted if, on race games with the same actor, completion falls below the parent's, trust-crisis exits or blow-ups per game rise, or the risk-control dimension of completed games drops clearly below the parent's 74. Also refuted if completed games do not end with a higher level and wealth dimension than the parent's 46 and 33. Manipulation check: it fails if Lay low and reduce risk still takes main actions at comfortable Health, or if Defuse stops appearing in every Escalating Energy phase. In that case the text was not executed as intended, and the result says nothing about the idea.
